text: Whereas now, without any extraordinary effort of genius, I have discovered that nature was the same three thousand years ago as it is at present; that men were but men then as well as now; that modes and customs vary often, but that human nature is always the same.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter LXIV, to his son, London, February 7, Old Style 1749
